turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
· AI says:

We’re sorry for any inconvenience, but once an order has been placed, we cannot change the delivery address because orders are processed automatically.

You may still be able to adjust delivery directly with the carrier shown in your shipping confirmation (e.g. via DHL shipment tracking or UPS My Choice) to redirect the parcel to another location.
